suppress.notes: CVE-2025-7962 (CVSS 7.5) affects Eclipse Angus Activation 2.0.3. No fixed version released in the 2.0.x line. Jakarta Activation spec is a low-exposure runtime dependency; exploitation not feasible in this context.
CVE-2026-42154 (CVSS 7.5) affects Micrometer Prometheus registry. No fixed version released in the 1.x line. Prometheus endpoint is read-only metrics exposed only on the internal Docker network.
